Card Q&A.q: Which player chooses which of my opponent's security cards is trashed by this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes, you can activate it.When a revealed card is trashed from the deck or security stack, it is not considered to be trashed from the deck or security stack, but it is considered that a card was removed from the security stack, so [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect can be activated.
